charge: Destruction of Property in the First Degree: One Restoration Hardware throw pillow, valued at $249

dialogue.speaker: judge
dialogue.line: Court is now in session. The charge is destruction of a decorative pillow. How does the defendant plead?

dialogue.speaker: defense
dialogue.line: NOT GUILTY, Your Honor! My client was conducting a critical safety inspection. Have YOU ever tested YOUR pillows for structural integrity?

dialogue.speaker: prosecution
dialogue.line: Your Honor, there is stuffing in three different rooms. THREE. I found foam in the bathtub.

dialogue.speaker: defendant
dialogue.line: I thought it was snowing inside. It was magical.

dialogue.speaker: judge
dialogue.line: The court notes that the defendant shows zero remorse and appears to be wagging.

dialogue.speaker: defense
dialogue.line: I cite the landmark case of Biscuit vs. The Couch Cushion, 2019, which established that unattended soft furnishings constitute an implicit invitation to quality testing!

dialogue.speaker: prosecution
dialogue.line: I just wanted one nice thing. Just one.

dialogue.speaker: judge
dialogue.line: Verdict: NOT GUILTY. The court recommends the prosecution invest in dog-proof furniture. Case dismissed.

verdict_reason: Unattended soft furnishings constitute an implicit invitation to quality testing under the Biscuit Precedent of 2019
